items.title: [CISA KEV] UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd - UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-114713
廠商: UnrealIRCd
產品: UnrealIRCd
漏洞名稱: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
說明: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

items.title: [CISA KEV] Check Point Multiple Products - Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-123039
廠商: Check Point
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
說明: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
